name: EMPAT SATU (41)
description: Empat Satu (which means 'Forty-One' in Indonesian) is a fast-paced draw-and-discard card game popular throughout Southeast Asia. The game is a test of optimization where players manage a small 4-card hand, attempting to collect four cards of the same suit. The legendary '41' is achieved by holding an Ace and three 10-value cards of the same suit. Because hands are small and the deck is large, the game moves rapidly, often ending in just a few turns when a player 'knocks' or declares a stop.

content.text: Empat Satu (which means 'Forty-One' in Indonesian) is a fast-paced draw-and-discard card game popular throughout Southeast Asia. The game is a test of optimization where players manage a small 4-card hand, attempting to collect four cards of the same suit. The legendary '41' is achieved by holding an Ace and three 10-value cards of the same suit. Because hands are small and the deck is large, the game moves rapidly, often ending in just a few turns when a player 'knocks' or declares a stop.
Originating in Indonesia as a social card game, Empat Satu is widely played in coffee shops and community gatherings. Its simplicity makes it accessible across all age groups.
2 to 4 players. Each plays for themselves.
The dealer gives 4 cards to each player, one at a time. The rest of the deck forms the face-down Stock. The top card of the Stock is turned over to start the Discard Pile.
